svg.title: See queued work and cancel it
svg.desc: Explicit CLI/MCP budgets cover daemon connection retries and readiness; read/fetch/download share their original budget with store acquisition and one-shot fallback. After the execution deadline, CLI/MCP reply reads allow at most 100 ms to receive the daemon’s failure and cancellation details. This does not extend execution: a complete success received after the execution deadline is rejected, and an incomplete or later reply yields a local deadline error. Blocking request writes are unchanged, so this is a bound on connection/reply waiting rather than a hard whole-call wall-clock guarantee. Refused/full UNIX connections retry for at most one second within that budget; a missing socket keeps immediate cold startup.
